stage: source-preparation-only; first cost requires separate root GO and F functional admission

compression.nice_len: unchanged preset default, not F nice32

policy.input: NUL-free bounded LF/CRLF text; final non-newline EOF admitted; max32767 bytes before LF including CR
policy.overflow_line: one-byte boundary lookahead; drain through LF/EOF then discard entire overlong line
policy.numbers: ASCII decimal 0..LLONG_MAX; first digit/full-token/unsigned-saturation check; invalid maps to0; no signed or scanf overflow
policy.GO: wtime/btime/winc/binc exact keys, any order, last duplicate; missing number consumes one following token as A/F; opposite-only is absent
policy.time: absent own clock1000ms; present zero/invalid min1; original clock/30+clampedinc*3/4 and clock/5/final86400000 caps
policy.commands: exact first command token; no-argument extra tokens ignored; unsupported stop/newgame/infinite tolerated without implementing them
policy.position: same legal membership/make child; scratch Board/history; commit only after complete replay; original A parse unchanged
policy.lifetime: unchanged fallback, startup pool, wait/result/pending/epoch/output fences, quit/EOF joins
policy.non_equivalence: NUL drain and some malformed extra/empty-command behavior differ; not general semantic-preserving compression
